mentions.name: Pascal IDE for iOS
mentions.description: A small Pascal IDE for iOS that runs Pascal code locally on the device, includes example programs, and features a Turbo Pascal–style theme for nostalgia.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on a small Pascal IDE for iOS.

It runs code locally (written in Swift), includes examples, and has a Turbo Pascal–style theme for max nostalgia.
